title: DepEd leads launch of Ahunan expanded digital access in Pakil schools

blocks.text: Education Secretary Sonny Angara on Wednesday led the launch of an initiative expanding reliable internet access in public schools in Pakil, Laguna, through a partnership between the department’s Laguna school’s division, Prime Infra and Ahunan Power. Angara said reliable connectivity can help schools and students cope with disruptions caused by severe weather. “This is life-changing for students and teachers especially in calamities,” Angara said at the launch. He said students in some schools miss as many as 40-50 days of classes because of calamities. The partnership was formalized in a memorandum of agreement (MOA) for the rollout of reliable internet connectivity […]...
